newsitem.title: JAPAN: Poll shows high support rate for Japan government.
newsitem.headline: Poll shows high support rate for Japan government.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's minority government is maintaining strong public support, according to a poll published on Wednesday.

The survey by Japan's mass-circulation daily Asahi Shimbun showed that 53 percent of those polled supported the Hashimoto cabinet, while 29 percent disapproved. The remaining 18 percent gave no response.
The support rate for the new Japanese government was almost unchanged from the 55 percent shown in a telephone poll conducted by Asahi immediately after Hashimoto chose his new cabinet on November 7.
The latest survey, conducted over the weekend, polled 3,000 people nationwide, of whom 78 percent responded.

Among those who expressed support for the new government, 17 percent said they appreciated the fact that the conservative Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) was in control. Another 10 percent of the supporters approved of Hashimoto's efforts to introduce administrative reform.
Hashimoto has listed administrative reform as his cabinet's top priority amid growing public criticism and distrust for Japan's politics and bureaucracy.
Support for the LDP itself was 34 percent, compared to the 35 percent who said they did not support any political party.
